info.title: RideMatch API
info.description: Backend API for RideMatch — a multi-modal (car, okada, keke, bus) ride/logistics matching platform for Nigeria. Authentication is phone number + OTP based; there is no password field. All responses use a single envelope shape: `{ success, message, data, error }`.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Phone + OTP authentication and token lifecycle

tags.name: Driver
tags.description: Driver registration, online/offline, live location, and nearby-driver search

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Staff-only: driver document verification and subscription activation

tags.description: Driver daily-access subscription checkout via Flutterwave, and its payment webhook

BearerAuth.description: Access token returned from /auth/otp/verify or /auth/token/refresh. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

phone.description: Any common Nigerian phone format: 080..., 234..., or +234...

name.description: Used only on first-time registration; ignored on login.

id_document_url.description: Government ID or driver's license photo, hosted at a URL reachable by the backend. Never returned by any read endpoint.

offered_price_kobo.description: Passenger's asking price, in kobo (NGN x 100)

price_kobo.description: Driver's proposed price, in kobo (NGN x 100)

pickup_pin.description: One-time plaintext 4-digit pickup PIN. Returned only here — show it to the driver in person at pickup. Never returned by any other endpoint.

pin.description: 4-digit pickup PIN the passenger shows the driver in person

days.description: Days of platform access to pay for

redirect_url.description: Where Flutterwave sends the driver after payment (defaults to FLW_REDIRECT_URL)

payment_link.description: Open this in a browser/WebView to complete payment

FlutterwaveWebhookPayload.description: Sent by Flutterwave, not constructed by API clients. Shown here for documentation completeness.

post.description: Sends a 6-digit one-time code by SMS to the given Nigerian phone number. Used for both first-time registration and subsequent logins — the same endpoint covers both. Subject to a resend cooldown (default 60s) per phone number.

post.summary: Verify an OTP and obtain access/refresh tokens
post.description: Verifies the 6-digit code sent to a phone number. If no account exists for the phone number yet, one is created automatically (pass `name` on first verification). Returns a JWT access token and an opaque refresh token.

400.description: Missing/invalid fields, incorrect or expired code

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: Rotates the refresh token: the submitted token is revoked and a new access + refresh token pair is issued. The old refresh token cannot be reused.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or already-used refresh token

post.description: Revokes the given refresh token, ending that session. Other devices/sessions for the same user are unaffected.

Creates a driver profile for the authenticated account and promotes it to the "driver" role. Vehicle photo and ID document must already be hosted somewhere reachable by URL. Starts in "pending" verification status.

409.description: Already registered, or plate number taken

post.description: Marks the driver online and publishes their live position so they appear in nearby-driver searches. Requires an approved driver profile and an active subscription.
Marks the driver offline and removes them from nearby-driver searches.

Updates the driver's live position. Call periodically (every 5-10 seconds) while online — a driver who stops pinging is treated as stale and dropped from nearby-driver results after the configured timeout (default 45s).

get.description: Passenger-facing: returns online drivers of the given vehicle type near a point, nearest first. Coordinates in the response are rounded, not exact, until a match is confirmed.

patch.summary: Approve or reject a driver's documents

patch.description: Stand-in for the Flutterwave payment webhook (not yet wired up) — grants the driver N days of platform access from now, or extends from their current expiry if still active.

post.description: Opens a new trip request and instantly notifies nearby online drivers of the matching vehicle type over WebSocket (and indexes it for GET /trips/nearby polling). A passenger may only have one active trip at a time.

get.description: Returns the caller's in-progress trip (requested/matched/picked_up), if any.
Driver-facing REST fallback for the WebSocket push — open (unmatched) trip requests near a point, for the given vehicle type, nearest first.

post.summary: Make a price offer on a trip
post.description: A driver proposes a price for an open trip request. Placing a new offer while one is already pending from the same driver updates that offer's price rather than creating a duplicate. Requires the driver to be online, verified, and subscribed.

get.summary: List pending offers on a trip

post.description: Matches the trip to the offering driver and generates a one-time pickup PIN, returned only in this response. Every other offering driver is notified the trip has closed.

400.description: Trip or offer no longer open

post.summary: Confirm pickup with the passenger's PIN
post.description: The driver enters the 4-digit PIN the passenger shows them in person, proving the pickup actually happened.
Either the passenger or the matched driver may cancel, but only before pickup is confirmed.

400.description: Trip can no longer be cancelled

get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket connection that pushes trip lifecycle events (new offers, match confirmed, pickup confirmed, trip completed/cancelled) the instant they happen, instead of the app having to poll. Authenticate by passing the access token as a query parameter, since standard WebSocket clients cannot set an Authorization header during the handshake: `wss://.../ws?token=<access_token>`. Every event pushed here is also readable via the corresponding REST endpoint — treat this as a low-latency notification channel, not the source of truth. Message envelope: `{"type": "trip.matched", "data": {...}}`.

post.description: Creates a Flutterwave hosted-checkout link for N days of platform access (default 1, max 30). Nothing is granted yet — access activates only once the payment webhook confirms the charge; poll GET /driver/profile afterward to see `has_active_subscription` flip to true.

404.description: Not registered as a driver yet

post.description: Called by Flutterwave when a charge completes. Verified two ways before anything is credited: the `verif-hash` header must match FLW_WEBHOOK_SECRET_HASH, and the transaction is independently re-fetched from Flutterwave's API before the driver's subscription is activated. Configure this URL as your webhook endpoint in the Flutterwave dashboard. Not for use by API clients directly.

parameters.name: verif-hash
parameters.description: Shared secret configured in the Flutterwave dashboard

200.description: Webhook processed (or safely ignored, e.g. an unhandled event type)
